issue: No candidate has a retrieved 2–3 m complete-tube compression scale, m and effective size. Measure a relevant population, including joints/process/environment; do not substitute tensile or flexural fits.
Manufacturer typical compression averages are not Weibull scales, design allowables or specimen-size fits. All multipliers against them are explicitly hypothetical.
Virtual matrix/transverse/shear constants, density mixtures and homogenized B=0/D=Qbar t³/12 need construction-specific evidence; actual pultruded/wrapped geometry and fibre fractions may differ.
Transverse compression, interlaminar damage, microbuckling, defects, matrix shear and compression-after-impact remain incomplete. No CFRP tube is established to be non-brittle.
Peak-stress orthotropic Donnell screen with inherited gamma is unvalidated. The change from .6E axial demand materially reduces the baseline 019 margin.
Rigid joints, global factor0.2, follower-pressure fan and lack of film tangent stiffness are projections; proof by nonlinear imperfection-sensitive structure tests/analysis is absent.
Every sampled loss triggers a second overload in the retained design. A changed load path, stronger joints and supported film bay must be designed with its mass charged.
Two static edge removals per construction/reserve are not an exhaustive edge search, transient rupture chain or lifetime cascade probability.
Pressure history/contact patch, preload, dynamic plate/shell response, effective flaw area and matching member-break fit are missing. Uncalibrated probabilities are not measured risks.
First-ply stress, leakage and complete-member severance are distinct events; tow load sharing cannot supply an impact Weibull population.

750 equal whole-member populations, 3 m reference weights and 1 cm³ volume weights are alternative hypotheses. Real compressive failure or composite load sharing may not follow weakest-link volume scaling.

Saint-Gobain sheet/web m/E/rho entries differ; Specialty Materials metric and imperial entries conflict; reported PremaTech flexural mean/scale are not internally exact. Preserve source populations instead of silently combining them.
GE's >1 GPa CMC compression concerns hot component averages; projected RT tube use and assumed E/G/rho are not justified by those data.
Fixed OD, actual f5 member lengths, retained film/joints and declared layups bound this study. Passing witnesses are not global minima or commercially demonstrated tubes.
Hail flux, repeated impact, humidity/temperature, manufacturing scatter, stress corrosion and proof-test damage are unmodeled. No actual lifetime Pf is identified.
The inherited flat stiffness/density trend does not constrain defect reduction, strength scatter, interfaces, proof testing or structural redundancy.
